name: end_call
description: Signal that the conversation is naturally complete and the caller is ready to hang up: you have asked whether there is anything else and they said no, or they said goodbye. Never say goodbye before that question has been answered. You MUST write your warm sign-off in the SAME response as this call — thank them for calling and wish them well. Nothing you say after this is heard.

reason.description: Brief reason the call is ending

name: book_appointment
description: Book an appointment. First ask ONE question that names the day, the time and the name — e.g. "So that's Tuesday at 3 p.m. for Jon Doe, is that right?" — and wait for the answer. Call this only after they answer with anything but a no, never in the same response as that question. Ask any spelling or extra-or-move question BEFORE that one question. If the caller changes a booking you made earlier on this call ("no, 10 instead"), that one question names the move — "Shall I move your 9 a.m. to 10 a.m.?" — and calling this with the new time moves that booking; it never adds a second one.

client_name.description: The caller's full name, exactly as THEY gave it on this call. Never invent one, never use a placeholder such as 'Jane Doe' or 'John Smith', and never take a name from an earlier record the caller has not confirmed. If they have not told you their name yet, ask them for it and wait for the answer before calling this.

service_type.description: Type of service or consultation requested

notes.description: Any additional notes about the appointment or client needs

in_addition_to_existing.description: Set true ONLY after you have told the caller they already have an upcoming appointment and they confirmed they want this new one AS WELL AS that one. Never set it pre-emptively — booking is refused without it when the caller already has an appointment.

name: record_customer_request
description: Record a message or callback request after collecting the caller's name, callback number, and message (and preferred callback time for callbacks). Call this when the caller wants to leave a message or have someone call them back.

request_type.description: Whether this is a message to pass along or a request for a callback

message.description: The message or reason for callback

preferred_time.description: When they prefer to be called back (for callback type)

caller_type.description: What kind of caller this is, whenever you can tell. Leave it out if unsure.

details.description: The caller's answers to this business's extra questions, one entry per question they answered. Skip anything they would rather not answer.

label.description: The question, in a few words (e.g. Company)

name: request_transfer
description: Transfer the caller to a human. Use when the caller asks for a person/representative/manager in any language, or when you cannot help and transfer is appropriate.

name: record_sms_consent
description: Record whether the caller agreed to receive a text message. Call this immediately after asking the text-confirmation question, with granted=true if they said yes and granted=false if they said no. Never send or promise a text before this has returned success.

granted.description: true if the caller agreed to be texted, false if they declined

name: get_caller_appointments
description: Look up the caller's upcoming appointments in the EHR.

name: get_available_slots
description: Get available appointment slots for a given date and optional service type.

name: book_appointment_in_ehr
description: Book an appointment in the EHR for the caller.

name: cancel_appointment
description: Cancel an existing appointment for the caller. Requires their name and date of birth to verify identity, plus the date of the appointment to cancel.

appointment_date.description: Date of the appointment to cancel (YYYY-MM-DD)

appointment_time.description: Time of the appointment to cancel (HH:MM, optional)

name: reschedule_appointment
description: Reschedule an existing appointment to a new date and time. Requires the caller's name and date of birth, the current appointment date, and the desired new date.

current_appointment_time.description: Time of the existing appointment (HH:MM, optional)
